decision: Telemetry a landing zone produces must be stored, queried, and billed within that landing zone.
why: A shared workspace merges ingestion costs across landing zones, which breaks the cost ownership model.

links.note: Azure Policy configures diagnostic settings that route telemetry to the landing-zone workspace.

violations: Centralized Log Analytics workspace for general purpose logs.
Diagnostic setting in a landing zone sending logs to a workspace in another subscription.
